trials.title: A Study Evaluating Efruxifermin in Subjects With Compensated Cirrhosis Due to NASH/MASH

primaryOutcomes.measure: Time from randomization to the first significant clinical event including disease progression, liver decompensation events, etc.
Cohort 1 only: Proportion of subjects with ≥ 1 stage improvement in fibrosis and no worsening of steatohepatitis

reasons: one of only 3 trials at this company

signals.text: Primary completion pushed out 5 months vs original registration (Jul 2024): Sep 2029 to Feb 2030 (1 move on record)
signals.read: Moderate delay. One slip is common; repeated slips are the signal.
Sample size increased. After an interim it usually means the effect size came in below the powering assumption; before enrollment it can mean new cohorts or geographies.

trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind. Targeting 2,150 patients vs 1,150 at registration (+87%). Started Oct 2024 (planned Jun 2024), primary completion Feb 2030 vs Sep 2029 at registration (+5 mo, 1 moves). Recruiting opened Jul 2024.
